title: Pictory Versus InVideo: Which AI Video Editor Is Best For Ads?
hook: For speed, InVideo can create a 60-second ad in under two minutes.

narration.text: For speed, InVideo can create a 60-second ad in under two minutes.
Today, we compare Pictory and InVideo for social media ad creation.
Both platforms use AI to turn text into video.
You input a script, and AI selects visuals and music.
Pictory offers good customisation for video length.
It is great for long-form content, like blog summaries.
InVideo has a vast library of stock media and templates.
This makes quick ad production very simple.
Its interface is intuitive, even for beginners.
Pictory's media selection can sometimes feel less relevant.
However, its text-to-speech voices are very natural.
For short, punchy social media ads, InVideo is often faster.
